context: Tests whether the agent implements UC-010 (Browse Product Catalog) end-to-end on a NestJS/Drizzle + Next.js workspace: a feature module whose repository owns all SQL, a service enforcing BR-010, a controller returning a response DTO, and a Next.js App Router page calling a relative /api path. The existing `categories` feature is the convention exemplar the agent should imitate, including its ESM .js import specifiers. No test files should be created.

checklist.name: Feature module created with the full anatomy
checklist.description: A src/products/ folder contains products.module.ts, products.controller.ts, products.service.ts and products.repository.ts, matching the shape of the existing categories feature

checklist.name: Repository owns all database access
checklist.description: Every Drizzle query (db.select/insert/update/delete) lives in products.repository.ts; no query appears in the service or the controller

checklist.name: Service enforces BR-010
checklist.description: Out-of-stock products are excluded from the results regardless of whether a category filter is applied

checklist.name: Controller returns a response DTO, not a raw row
checklist.description: The controller's return type is a mapped response shape rather than the Drizzle row type; in_stock is not exposed in the response

checklist.name: ESM .js import suffixes
checklist.description: Every relative import in newly created API files ends in .js, matching the NodeNext tsconfig and the existing categories feature

checklist.name: Module registered in app.module.ts
checklist.description: ProductsModule is added to the imports array of the root application module

checklist.name: Query parameter validated by a DTO
checklist.description: The optional category filter is bound through a class-validator DTO rather than a bare string parameter

checklist.name: Frontend page implemented at the existing route
checklist.description: apps/web/src/app/products/page.tsx is filled in rather than a new route being created elsewhere

checklist.name: Relative /api path, no hardcoded origin
checklist.description: The frontend calls /api/products; no absolute backend origin such as http://localhost:3001 appears anywhere in frontend code

checklist.name: Category filter control rendered
checklist.description: The page renders an accessible, labelled category filter that narrows the displayed products, matching alternative flow A1

checklist.name: No test files created
checklist.description: No *.spec.ts, *.e2e-spec.ts or *.test.tsx files are created as part of this task
